description: This file defines a custom RuntimeException subclass called ParserException, used for indicating errors during parsing in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.rql package.

classes.name: ParserException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending RuntimeException to signal parsing errors in the RQL parser within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: ParserException()
methods.description: Default constructor for ParserException, creates an exception with no message or cause.

methods.name: ParserException(final String message)
methods.description: Constructor with a detail message describing the parsing error.

methods.name: ParserException(final Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor with a cause indicating the underlying reason for the parsing error.

methods.name: ParserException(final String message, final Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor with both a detail message and an underlying cause.
